id: \rClay can be a bit rough to deal with. Don't mind his impatience though. He eventually comes around. I think...
en: \rClay can be a bit rough to deal with. Don't mind his impatience though. He eventually comes around. I think...
it: \rRafan può essere un tipo difficile da gestire. Ma non badare alla sua impazienza. Alla fine si ammorbidisce. Credo...

id: \bDoes my life have meaning? Does life make sense? I mean there's three houses in the city. Where does everyone live? What do I do other than stand here?
en: \bDoes my life have meaning? Does life make sense?  I mean there's three houses in the city. Where does everyone live? What do I do other than stand here?
it: \bLa mia vita ha un senso? La vita ha un senso? Voglio dire, ci sono tre case in città. Dove vivono tutti? Cosa faccio, a parte starmene qui?

id: \bI hope this place opens soon. I want to try it out.
en: \bI hope this place opens soon. I want to try it out.
it: \bSpero che questo posto apra presto. Voglio provarlo.

id: \bIt's finally open!
en: \bIt's finally open!
it: \bFinalmente è aperto!

id: \rZorua
en: \rZorua
it: \rZorua

id: \bWe are trying to have a moment. Do you mind?
en: \bWe are trying to have a moment. Do you mind?
it: \bStiamo cercando di avere un momento tutto nostro. Ti dispiace?

id: \bHave you been to the market yet?
en: \bHave you been to the market yet?
it: \bSei già stato al mercato?

id: \bClay won't take my battle. How am I supposed to earn the badge?
en: \bClay won't take my battle. How am I supposed to earn the badge?
it: \bRafan non accetta la mia sfida. Come faccio a ottenere la medaglia?

id: \bJoltik
en: \bJoltik
it: \bJoltik

id: \bThe bridge is free to cross. Want to go?
en: \bThe bridge is free to cross. Want to go?
it: \bIl ponte si può attraversare. Vuoi andare?

id: \bVery well. Enjoy your day.
en: \bVery well. Enjoy your day.
it: \bMolto bene. Buona giornata.

id: \rThank you for visiting the market. Take this as a thank you from management.
en: \rThank you for visiting the market. Take this as a thank you from management.
it: \rGrazie per aver visitato il mercato. Prendi questo come ringraziamento da parte della direzione.

id: \rBe sure to visit the store!
en: \rBe sure to visit the store!
it: \rNon dimenticare di visitare il negozio!

id: \bRyuki: They won't let me inside...saying I'm not a real Gym Leader. But I am. I'm the true star of the show. Let me show you.
en: \bRyuki: They won't let me inside...saying I'm not a real Gym Leader. But I am. I'm the true star of the show. Let me show you.
it: \bRyuki: Non mi fanno entrare... dicono che non sono un vero Capopalestra. Ma lo sono. Sono la vera star dello spettacolo. Te lo dimostro.

id: \bRyuki: What a gig. If we play it loud enough I'll be recognized.
en: \bRyuki: What a gig. If we play it loud enough I'll be recognized.
it: \bRyuki: Che concerto. Se suoniamo abbastanza forte, mi riconosceranno.

id: \bThe Battle House is being set up. Come back later.
en: \bThe Battle House is being set up. Come back later.
it: \bLa Casa Lotta è in allestimento. Torna più tardi.

id: \bCan't you see what's going on here? Scram kid.
en: \bCan't you see what's going on here? Scram kid.
it: \bNon vedi cosa sta succedendo qui? Sparisci, ragazzino.

id: \bClay: You came here for a gym battle, huh?
en: \bClay: You came here for a gym battle, huh?
it: \bRafan: Sei venuto qui per una lotta in Palestra, eh?

id: \bToo bad. I'm in no mood for a battle so get lost.
en: \bToo bad. I'm in no mood for a battle so get lost.
it: \bPeccato. Non sono dell'umore per lottare, quindi sparisci.

id: \bI have bigger problems to deal with than you. Apparently the Forces of Nature are causing havoc on Milos Island.
en: \bI have bigger problems to deal with than you.  Apparently the Forces of Nature are causing havoc on Milos Island.
it: \bHo problemi più grossi di te da affrontare. A quanto pare le Forze della Natura stanno seminando il caos sull'Isola Milos.

id: \bClay: I have bigger problems to deal with than you. Apparently the Foces of Nature are causing havoc on Milos Island.
en: \bClay: I have bigger problems to deal with than you.  Apparently the Foces of Nature are causing havoc on Milos Island.
it: \bRafan: Ho problemi più grossi di te da affrontare. A quanto pare le Forze della Natura stanno seminando il caos sull'Isola Milos.

id: \bChili: \PN. You just missed Cilan. He taught me some new tricks and a move, Solar Beam. Why not help me try it out.
en: \bChili: \PN. You just missed Cilan. He taught me some new tricks and a move, Solar Beam. Why not help me try it out.
it: \bChicco: \PN. Hai appena mancato Spighetto. Mi ha insegnato qualche trucco nuovo e una mossa, Solarraggio. Perché non mi aiuti a provarla?

id: \bChili: Argh. I still can't win. We'll just have to keep training. Thanks for helping.
en: \bChili: Argh. I still can't win. We'll just have to keep training. Thanks for helping.
it: \bChicco: Argh. Ancora non riesco a vincere. Dovremo continuare ad allenarci. Grazie per l'aiuto.

id: \bClay taught me a useful move. I can teach you as well.
en: \bClay taught me a useful move. I can teach you as well.
it: \bRafan mi ha insegnato una mossa utile. Posso insegnarla anche a te.

id: \bWant to learn Drill Run?
en: \bWant to learn Drill Run?
it: \bVuoi imparare Giravvita?

id: \bCome back anytime!
en: \bCome back anytime!
it: \bTorna quando vuoi!

en: \rHave you met my friend?
it: \rHai conosciuto il mio amico?

en: \rCharles means well. Together we both fight crime in the area. Just the other day we stopped Dr. Ferrara.
it: \rCharles ha buone intenzioni. Insieme combattiamo il crimine in zona. Proprio l'altro giorno abbiamo fermato il Dott. Ferrara.

en: Driftveil Market
it: Mercato di Libecciopoli

id: \bThe gym uses Ground types. That's not very common. Hope you're prepared.
en: \bThe gym uses Ground types. That's not very common. Hope you're prepared.
it: \bLa Palestra usa Pokémon di tipo Terra. Non è molto comune. Spero che tu sia preparato.

id: \bHow did you know?
en: \bHow did you know?
it: \bCome facevi a saperlo?

id: \bDon't tell anyone about me.
en: \bDon't tell anyone about me.
it: \bNon dire a nessuno di me.

id: \bYou want to use my boat? Not a chance kid.
en: \bYou want to use my boat? Not a chance kid.
it: \bVuoi usare la mia barca? Neanche per sogno, ragazzino.

id: \bClay said you could go did he? Alright then, you ready?
en: \bClay said you could go did he? Alright then, you ready?
it: \bRafan ha detto che puoi andare, eh? Va bene, allora, sei pronto?

id: \bFine with me.
en: \bFine with me.
it: \bPer me va bene.

it: \bVorrei pescare da questa città. Il ponte è troppo alto perché abbocchi qualcosa e la sponda è troppo ripida per scendere.

id: \rI'm afraid of water. Staring at it helps me calm down.
en: \rI'm afraid of water. Staring at it helps me calm down.
it: \rHo paura dell'acqua. Fissarla mi aiuta a calmarmi.

id: \rDon't bother me right now. Just take this and leave.
en: \rDon't bother me right now. Just take this and leave.
it: \rNon disturbarmi adesso. Prendi questo e vattene.
